race.description: Nijinsky Standing At Yirribee Stud Pace
race.comment: UNCLE TREV (5) ran fourth last start at Kilmore over 2180m, beaten 12 metres. Must raise the bar but a win is on the cards. SWEET NICKY (3) has been competitive of late and kept the ball rolling last time when a head from the winner in second over 1740m at this track. A nice draw on the front line should ensure a cosy run. Meets a comparable field and she can figure in the finish. CORZAN DRAMA (9) has each-way claims following a respectable third at his most recent appearance over 1740m at this track. DANCINGONSTARLIGHT (8) is in the mix if she can recapture the form from two starts back that saw her score over 1740m at this track.
